        if (isOneTrustBannerClickHandlerRegistered) {

        const oneTrustBannerElement = document.querySelector("#onetrust-banner-sdk");

          });

      function listenCookieChange(callback, interval = 2000) {
        let lastCookie = document.cookie;

          let cookie = document.cookie;

            OptanonWrapper();
          }, 2000);
        }, 2000)
      });

    <script>
      class EYLogoAnimation {
            constructor(ele) {
              this.element = ele;
              this.firstLine = this.element.querySelector(
                "#ey-logo-first-line rect"
              );
              this.secondLine = this.element.querySelector(
                "#ey-logo-second-line rect"
              );
              if (this.firstLine && this.secondLine) {
                this.bindEvents();
                this.animation(false);
              }
            }

            animation(scrollBool) {
              if (scrollBool) {
                if (window.scrollY == 0) {
                  this.firstLine.setAttribute("class", "slideIn");
                  this.secondLine.setAttribute("class", "slideIn");
                }
                if (window.scrollY !== 0) {
                  this.firstLine.setAttribute("class", "slideOut");
                  this.secondLine.setAttribute("class", "slideOut");
                }
              }
            }

            bindEvents() {
              window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
                this.animation(true);
              });
            }
          }

          document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            document
              .querySelectorAll(".cmp-logo__image")
              .forEach((eysvglogo) => {
                new EYLogoAnimation(eysvglogo);
              });
          });
    </script>

    <script type="text/javascript">
      let cookierecheckInterval = 0;
      const cookiecheckingIterations = 15;
      const PERFORMANCE_COOKIE_CODE = "C0002";
      const MARKETING_COOKIE_CODE = "C0004";
      let isOneTrustAcceptButtonClicked = false;
      let isOneTrustBannerClickHandlerRegistered = false;

      function registerOneTrustBannerClickHandler() {
        if (isOneTrustBannerClickHandlerRegistered) {
          return;
        }

        const oneTrustBannerElement = document.querySelector("#onetrust-banner-sdk");
        if (!oneTrustBannerElement) {
          return;
        }

        oneTrustBannerElement.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          const targetElement = event.target;
          if (!(targetElement instanceof Element)) {
            return;
          }

          if (targetElement.closest("#onetrust-accept-btn-handler")) {
            isOneTrustAcceptButtonClicked = true;
          }
        });

        isOneTrustBannerClickHandlerRegistered = true;
      }

      function OptanonWrapper() {
        registerOneTrustBannerClickHandler();

        const cookiePolicyElement = document.querySelectorAll(".up-cookie-policy-link");
        const cookiePolicyElement2 = document.querySelectorAll(".privacy-notice-link");
        const cookiePolicyModalElement = document.querySelector("#cookie-modal");
        const cookiePolicyPath = cookiePolicyModalElement?.getAttribute("data-cookie-policy-path");

        if (cookiePolicyPath) {
          cookiePolicyElement.forEach((item) => {
            item.setAttribute("href", cookiePolicyPath);
          });

          cookiePolicyElement2.forEach((item) => {
            item.setAttribute("href", cookiePolicyPath);
          });
        }

        if (typeof OptanonWrapperCount === "undefined" && !OneTrust.IsAlertBoxClosed()) {
          otInitialDelete();
        } else {
          pageInitialDelete();
        }

        function otInitialDelete() {
          OptanonWrapperCount = "";
          const consentInitialDeleteEvent = new CustomEvent("onetrust-initial-delete");
          window.dispatchEvent(consentInitialDeleteEvent);
        }

        function pageInitialDelete() {
          const onetrustAcceptedCookies = OptanonActiveGroups.split(",").filter((e) => e != "");
          const consentInitialDeleteEvent = new CustomEvent("onetrust-reload-cookie-check", {
            detail: onetrustAcceptedCookies,
          });
          window.dispatchEvent(consentInitialDeleteEvent);
        }

        OneTrust.OnConsentChanged(function (event) {
          const consentChangedEvent = new CustomEvent("onetrust-consent-changed", {
            detail: event.detail,
          });
          window.dispatchEvent(consentChangedEvent);
          if (OnetrustActiveGroups.includes(PERFORMANCE_COOKIE_CODE)) {
            adobe.optIn.approveAll();
            _satellite.track("OneTrust_Acceptance");
          } else if (!isOneTrustAcceptButtonClicked && OnetrustActiveGroups.includes(MARKETING_COOKIE_CODE)) {
            _satellite.track("OT_Marketing_Cookies");
          }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll("iframe").forEach((el) => {
          el.onload = () => OptanonWrapper();
        });
      }

      window.addEventListener(
        "modal-ot-cookie-validation",
        () => {
          OptanonWrapper();
        },
        false,
      );

      function listenCookieChange(callback, interval = 2000) {
        let lastCookie = document.cookie;
        const intervalCookie = setInterval(() => {
          let cookie = document.cookie;
          cookierecheckInterval++;
          if (cookierecheckInterval > cookiecheckingIterations) {
            clearInterval(intervalCookie);
          }
          if ((cookie !== lastCookie) || cookierecheckInterval === 1) {
            try {
              callback({ oldValue: lastCookie, newValue: cookie });
            } finally {
              lastCookie = cookie;
            }
          }
        }, interval);
      }

      //delaying cookie deletion to avoid interference with other rendering
      window.addEventListener("load", () => {
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          listenCookieChange(({ oldValue, newValue }) => {
            OptanonWrapper();
          }, 2000);
        }, 2000)
      });

    </script>

    <script>
      class EYLogoAnimation {
            constructor(ele) {
              this.element = ele;
              this.firstLine = this.element.querySelector(
                "#ey-logo-first-line rect"
              );
              this.secondLine = this.element.querySelector(
                "#ey-logo-second-line rect"
              );
              if (this.firstLine && this.secondLine) {
                this.bindEvents();
                this.animation(false);
              }
            }

            animation(scrollBool) {
              if (scrollBool) {
                if (window.scrollY == 0) {
                  this.firstLine.setAttribute("class", "slideIn");
                  this.secondLine.setAttribute("class", "slideIn");
                }
                if (window.scrollY !== 0) {
                  this.firstLine.setAttribute("class", "slideOut");
                  this.secondLine.setAttribute("class", "slideOut");
                }
              }
            }

            bindEvents() {
              window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
                this.animation(true);
              });
            }
          }

          document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            document
              .querySelectorAll(".cmp-logo__image")
              .forEach((eysvglogo) => {
                new EYLogoAnimation(eysvglogo);
              });
          });
    </script>

        <h3>What EY Transfer Pricing services can we offer you? </h3>
<p>Our integrated approach helps businesses align with global standards, manage tax risks, and streamline cross-border transactions. We support clients from planning and documentation to audits and dispute resolution.</p>
<p><b>Our services are designed to review, document, manage, and defend clients’ Transfer Pricing policies and processes while aligning them with their overall business strategy.</b></p>
<p>We collaborate closely with clients to develop proactive, pragmatic, and integrated TP and operating model strategies that address today’s complex tax risks while supporting long-term business goals. Our services span the full lifecycle, from planning and documentation to audit defense and dispute resolution, helping clients stay compliant in a rapidly evolving global tax environment. We offer comprehensive controversy management support, including audit representation before tax authorities and assistance with Advance Pricing Agreements (APA) and Mutual Agreement Procedures (MAP). We also provide robust support on Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) initiatives, including both BEPS 1.0 and 2.0 frameworks, enabling clients to navigate international tax reforms.</p>

        <p><b>We integrate advanced technology into our TP services to drive accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.</b></p>
<p>Our digital solutions help automate complex processes, enhance data management, and provide real-time insights—empowering businesses to meet regulatory compliance requirements, manage risks, and align TP operations with evolving global tax standards. Our key tools include:</p>
<ul><li><b>RPT Automation Solution: </b>Our proprietary platform automates the tracking, reconciliation, and compliance of related party transactions across Companies Act, SEBI LODR guidelines, and the Income-tax Act, 1961. It centralizes data, enhances governance, and streamlines reporting. By reducing manual effort and facilitating audit-ready documentation, RPT Automation Solution helps businesses mitigate compliance risks and efficiently meet disclosure requirements.<br />
 </li></ul>
<ul><li><b>DigiRev™:</b> A proprietary digital solution designed to collate evidence for intra-group services and royalty transactions by scanning emails and extracting relevant information using customized keyword algorithms. DigiRev™ enhances documentation quality, reduces manual effort, and improves data security. <a href="https://www.ey.com/en_in/services/tax/digital-strategy/digirev">https://www.ey.com/en_in/services/tax/digital-strategy/digirev</a><br />
 </li></ul>
<ul><li><b>TP Web™: </b>Our documentation platform helps meet BEPS Action 13 requirements through efficient, group-wide preparation of master and local files. It accommodates varying documentation structures and integrates with ERP systems for centralized, automated data collection. Customizable features—such as user-specific access and tailored reporting—enable scalable, secure monitoring and assessment, enhancing consistency, transparency, and compliance.<br />
 </li></ul>
<ul><li><b>TP Engine: </b>Our ready-to-deploy Operational Transfer Pricing platform is built on SAP and powered by a dedicated tax and TP data model. It manages intercompany transactions end-to-end—covering service allocations, royalties, profit splits, cost sharing, and supply chain analytics. With robust reporting and smart data ingestion, it enables adjustments, journal entries, and price list generation, improving transparency, automation, and compliance across jurisdictions.<br />
 </li></ul>
<ul><li><b>CbCR Web™:</b> Our dedicated Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) tool is developed to support MNEs in meeting CbCR compliance requirements. What EY Transfer Pricing services can do for you 2. FAQs 3. Our Team What EY Transfer Pricing services can we offer you?&nbsp;</h3>
<p>Our integrated approach helps businesses align with global standards, manage tax risks, and streamline cross-border transactions. We support clients from planning and documentation to audits and dispute resolution.</p>
<p><b>Our services are designed to review, document, manage, and defend clients’ Transfer Pricing policies and processes while aligning them with their overall business strategy.</b></p>
<p>We collaborate closely with clients to develop proactive, pragmatic, and integrated TP and operating model strategies that address today’s complex tax risks while supporting long-term business goals. Our services span the full lifecycle, from planning and documentation to audit defense and dispute resolution, helping clients stay compliant in a rapidly evolving global tax environment. We offer comprehensive controversy management support, including audit representation before tax authorities and assistance with Advance Pricing Agreements (APA) and Mutual Agreement Procedures (MAP). We also provide robust support on Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) initiatives, including both BEPS 1.0 and 2.0 frameworks, enabling clients to navigate international tax reforms.</p>

<p>Our services include the preparation of local files, master files, and country-by-country reports in accordance with Indian regulations and OECD Transfer Pricing guidelines. We assist in developing robust documentation that supports the arm’s length nature of intercompany transactions, minimizing audit risks and facilitating transparency. Our team works closely with clients to understand their business models and deliver tailored documentation. Read More Read Less Base Erosion and Profit Shifting 2.0: Pillar II <b>As jurisdictions around the world begin implementing global minimum tax rules under the OECD’s Pillar Two framework, multinational enterprises (MNEs) should proactively prepare for significant changes.</b></p>

acceptedAnswer.text:
We provide comprehensive TP compliance and documentation services to help clients meet regulatory requirements while aligning with global best practices.

Our services include the preparation of local files, master files, and country-by-country reports in accordance with Indian regulations and OECD Transfer Pricing guidelines. We assist in developing robust documentation that supports the arm’s length nature of intercompany transactions, minimizing audit risks and facilitating transparency. Our team works closely with clients to understand their business models and deliver tailored documentation. With deep technical knowledge and industry insights, our specialists help clients stay compliant, reduce penalty exposure, and navigate evolving regulatory landscapes.

mainEntity.name: Transfer Pricing planning and operating model effectiveness

acceptedAnswer.text:
We support clients in designing and implementing effective TP policies that are aligned with their commercial objectives and global value chains.

We translate business strategies into compliant and efficient TP frameworks with input from tax, customs, and accounting professionals. We provide functional and risk analyses, benchmarking, pricing model design, and alignment of intercompany agreements. We facilitate seamless policy integration into daily operations, enabling multi-jurisdictional consistency. We help businesses future-proof their TP strategies sustainably in a complex regulatory environment through value contribution analysis.

mainEntity.name: Base Erosion and Profit Shifting 2.0: Pillar II

acceptedAnswer.text:
As jurisdictions around the world begin implementing global minimum tax rules under the OECD’s Pillar Two framework, multinational enterprises (MNEs) should proactively prepare for significant changes.

Organizations are still in the early stages of transition to Pillar Two and face the challenge of calculating new tax liabilities, assessing financial statement impacts, and meeting complex global reporting obligations. We support clients through this transformation by providing impact assessments, gap analyses, and implementation support, helping them navigate the evolving global tax landscape with confidence.

mainEntity.name: Transfer Pricing controversy management and dispute resolution

acceptedAnswer.text:
In an era of heightened transparency and information sharing among tax authorities, we offer comprehensive controversy management services to help clients navigate complex TP disputes with confidence and strategic clarity.

We support clients through the full controversy lifecycle—from audit readiness and representation before tax and appellate authorities to resolution through APAs and MAPs. Our team blends technical knowledge with practical dispute experience, delivering tailored strategies that mitigate risk and drive sustainable outcomes in a highly regulated global tax environment.

We integrate advanced technology into our TP services to drive accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.

Our digital solutions help automate complex processes, enhance data management, and provide real-time insights—empowering businesses to meet regulatory compliance requirements, manage risks, and align TP operations with evolving global tax standards. Our key tools include:

  • RPT Automation Solution: Our proprietary platform automates the tracking, reconciliation, and compliance of related party transactions across Companies Act, SEBI LODR guidelines, and the Income-tax Act, 1961. It centralizes data, enhances governance, and streamlines reporting. By reducing manual effort and facilitating audit-ready documentation, RPT Automation Solution helps businesses mitigate compliance risks and efficiently meet disclosure requirements.
     
  • DigiRev™: A proprietary digital solution designed to collate evidence for intra-group services and royalty transactions by scanning emails and extracting relevant information using customized keyword algorithms. DigiRev™ enhances documentation quality, reduces manual effort, and improves data security. https://www.ey.com/en_in/services/tax/digital-strategy/digirev
     
  • TP Web™: Our documentation platform helps meet BEPS Action 13 requirements through efficient, group-wide preparation of master and local files. It accommodates varying documentation structures and integrates with ERP systems for centralized, automated data collection. Customizable features—such as user-specific access and tailored reporting—enable scalable, secure monitoring and assessment, enhancing consistency, transparency, and compliance.
     
  • TP Engine: Our ready-to-deploy Operational Transfer Pricing platform is built on SAP and powered by a dedicated tax and TP data model. It manages intercompany transactions end-to-end—covering service allocations, royalties, profit splits, cost sharing, and supply chain analytics. With robust reporting and smart data ingestion, it enables adjustments, journal entries, and price list generation, improving transparency, automation, and compliance across jurisdictions.
     
  • CbCR Web™: Our dedicated Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) tool is developed to support MNEs in meeting CbCR compliance requirements. It enables efficient centralized and automated data collection, validation, and management of CbCr reporting data by seamlessly integrating with commonly used ERP systems. Designed for scalability and accuracy, CbCR Web™ streamlines XML report preparation, automates data aggregation, and aligns with local filing standards.

mainEntity.name: Who is subject to Transfer Pricing regulations in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Transfer Pricing (TP) regulations apply to international transactions between associated enterprises, where at least one party is a non-resident. Certain specified domestic transactions between related Indian entities are also covered under Indian TP regulations. In certain circumstances, transactions with third parties may also fall under Indian TP regulations.

mainEntity.name: Which compliances are required under Indian Transfer Pricing regulations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Taxpayers must file Form 3CEB certified by a Chartered Accountant, and, if thresholds are met, maintain contemporaneous documentation including the Local File, Master File, and Country-by-Country Report.

mainEntity.name: What are the penalties for non-compliance with Transfer Pricing regulations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Penalties range from 2% to 6% of the transaction value for non-compliance, including failure to maintain documentation or report transaction, and for maintaining and furnishing incorrect details. An additional penalty of INR1,00,000 applies for not filing Form 3CEB. Further penalties may apply for under-reporting or misreporting income due to TP adjustments.

mainEntity.name: What are the alternate dispute resolution mechanisms available to the taxpayers in India for Transfer Pricing disputes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Indian TP regulations offer dispute resolution mechanisms such as Safe Harbour Rules, Advance Pricing Agreements (APAs), and Mutual Agreement Procedures (MAPs) to enhance certainty and prevent double taxation.

mainEntity.name: How can businesses proactively manage Transfer Pricing risks in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Businesses can manage TP risks by maintaining strong documentation, conducting regular benchmarking, implementing consistent policies, automating processes through technology, and leveraging APAs, MAPs, or Safe Harbour options for certainty and dispute avoidance.

      const MARKETING_COOKIE_CODE = "C0004";
      let isOneTrustAcceptButtonClicked = false;
      let isOneTrustBannerClickHandlerRegistered = false;

      function registerOneTrustBannerClickHandler() {
        if (isOneTrustBannerClickHandlerRegistered) {
          return;
        }

        const oneTrustBannerElement = document.querySelector("#onetrust-banner-sdk");
        if (!oneTrustBannerElement) {
          return;
        }

        oneTrustBannerElement.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          const targetElement = event.target;
          if (!(targetElement instanceof Element)) {
            return;
          }

          if (targetElement.closest("#onetrust-accept-btn-handler")) {
            isOneTrustAcceptButtonClicked = true;
          }
        });

        isOneTrustBannerClickHandlerRegistered = true;
      }

      function OptanonWrapper() {
        registerOneTrustBannerClickHandler();

        const cookiePolicyElement = document.querySelectorAll(".up-cookie-policy-link");
        const cookiePolicyElement2 = document.querySelectorAll(".privacy-notice-link");
        const cookiePolicyModalElement = document.querySelector("#cookie-modal");
        const cookiePolicyPath = cookiePolicyModalElement?.getAttribute("data-cookie-policy-path");

        if (cookiePolicyPath) {
          cookiePolicyElement.forEach((item) => {
            item.setAttribute("href", cookiePolicyPath);
          });

          cookiePolicyElement2.forEach((item) => {
            item.setAttribute("href", cookiePolicyPath);
          });
        }

        if (typeof OptanonWrapperCount === "undefined" && !OneTrust.IsAlertBoxClosed()) {
          otInitialDelete();
        } else {
          pageInitialDelete();
        }

        function otInitialDelete() {
          OptanonWrapperCount = "";
          const consentInitialDeleteEvent = new CustomEvent("onetrust-initial-delete");
          window.dispatchEvent(consentInitialDeleteEvent);
        }

        function pageInitialDelete() {
          const onetrustAcceptedCookies = OptanonActiveGroups.split(",").filter((e) => e != "");
          const consentInitialDeleteEvent = new CustomEvent("onetrust-reload-cookie-check", {
            detail: onetrustAcceptedCookies,
          });
          window.dispatchEvent(consentInitialDeleteEvent);
        }

        OneTrust.OnConsentChanged(function (event) {
          const consentChangedEvent = new CustomEvent("onetrust-consent-changed", {
            detail: event.detail,
          });
          window.dispatchEvent(consentChangedEvent);
          if (OnetrustActiveGroups.includes(PERFORMANCE_COOKIE_CODE)) {
            adobe.optIn.approveAll();
            _satellite.track("OneTrust_Acceptance");
          } else if (!isOneTrustAcceptButtonClicked && OnetrustActiveGroups.includes(MARKETING_COOKIE_CODE)) {
            _satellite.track("OT_Marketing_Cookies");
          }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll("iframe").forEach((el) => {
          el.onload = () => OptanonWrapper();
        });
      }

      window.addEventListener(
        "modal-ot-cookie-validation",
        () => {
          OptanonWrapper();
        },
        false,
      );

      function listenCookieChange(callback, interval = 2000) {
        let lastCookie = document.cookie;
        const intervalCookie = setInterval(() => {
          let cookie = document.cookie;
          cookierecheckInterval++;
          if (cookierecheckInterval > cookiecheckingIterations) {
            clearInterval(intervalCookie);
          }
          if ((cookie !== lastCookie) || cookierecheckInterval === 1) {
            try {
              callback({ oldValue: lastCookie, newValue: cookie });
            } finally {
              lastCookie = cookie;
            }
          }
        }, interval);
      }

      //delaying cookie deletion to avoid interference with other rendering
      window.addEventListener("load", () => {
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          listenCookieChange(({ oldValue, newValue }) => {
            OptanonWrapper();
          }, 2000);
        }, 2000)
      });

        <h2>What EY-Parthenon consumer strategy consulting team can do for you</h2>
<p>These are extraordinary times to be a consumer-facing company. As people change how and where they shop, and what they buy, retailers, consumer products, food and agribusiness companies must also swiftly pivot. While advances in technology, data capabilities and AI are accelerating this revolution, agility is the key to controlling it. Flexibility, ingenuity, and rapid response are the new hallmarks of success for consumer products and retail.</p>
<p>Bold action is required. Product, portfolio and customer experience must be rethought. To deliver excellence, your operating model and supply chain also need to be carefully re-examined. And all should be done in the context of sustainability and transparency. To be in full control, leaders must help create the future, not just respond to it.</p>
<p>EY-Parthenon consumer and retail strategy consulting professionals can aid your business transformation as you unlock the full potential of your company. Whether you are seeking business model reinvention, a digital transformation or a re-defined go-to-market strategy, we can work with you to help make the right corporate and growth strategy choices. Whether that involves building or buying your growth, we’ll help you determine the optimal M&A strategies and integration plans to achieve sustained success. We also offer a wide-ranging assistance with turnarounds and/or restructuring strategies from rapid performance improvement to contingency planning.</p>
<p>Whatever the business issue, EY-Parthenon consumer strategic insights — always bespoke — are based on deep industry knowledge, years of practical experience with state-of-the-art processes and fact-based projections about your industry’s future. Let EY-Parthenon teams help you sustain your company today while you transform it for tomorrow.</p>

Business model reinvention, digital transformation, go-to-market strategy, M&A strategies, turn-arounds, and restructuring plans are some of the ways we help unlock a company’s full potential. <p>These are extraordinary times to be a consumer-facing company. As people change how and where they shop, and what they buy, retailers, consumer products, food and agribusiness companies must also swiftly pivot. While advances in technology, data capabilities and AI are accelerating this revolution, agility is the key to controlling it. Flexibility, ingenuity, and rapid response are the new hallmarks of success for consumer products and retail.</p>
<p>Bold action is required. Product, portfolio and customer experience must be rethought. To deliver excellence, your operating model and supply chain also need to be carefully re-examined. And all should be done in the context of sustainability and transparency. To be in full control, leaders must help create the future, not just respond to it.</p>
<p>EY-Parthenon consumer and retail strategy consulting professionals can aid your business transformation as you unlock the full potential of your company. Whether you are seeking business model reinvention, a digital transformation or a re-defined go-to-market strategy, we can work with you to help make the right corporate and growth strategy choices. Whether that involves building or buying your growth, we’ll help you determine the optimal M&amp;A strategies and integration plans to achieve sustained success. We also offer a wide-ranging assistance with turnarounds and/or restructuring strategies from rapid performance improvement to contingency planning.</p>
<p>Whatever the business issue, EY-Parthenon consumer strategic insights — always bespoke — are based on deep industry knowledge, years of practical experience with state-of-the-art processes and fact-based projections about your industry’s future. Let EY-Parthenon teams help you sustain your company today while you transform it for tomorrow.</p>

    <script>
      class EYLogoAnimation {
            constructor(ele) {
              this.element = ele;
              this.firstLine = this.element.querySelector(
                "#ey-logo-first-line rect"
              );
              this.secondLine = this.element.querySelector(
                "#ey-logo-second-line rect"
              );
              if (this.firstLine && this.secondLine) {
                this.bindEvents();
                this.animation(false);
              }
            }

            animation(scrollBool) {
              if (scrollBool) {
                if (window.scrollY == 0) {
                  this.firstLine.setAttribute("class", "slideIn");
                  this.secondLine.setAttribute("class", "slideIn");
                }
                if (window.scrollY !== 0) {
                  this.firstLine.setAttribute("class", "slideOut");
                  this.secondLine.setAttribute("class", "slideOut");
                }
              }
            }

            bindEvents() {
              window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
                this.animation(true);
              });
            }
          }

          document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            document
              .querySelectorAll(".cmp-logo__image")
              .forEach((eysvglogo) => {
                new EYLogoAnimation(eysvglogo);
              });
          });
    </script>

    <script>
      class EYLogoAnimation {
            constructor(ele) {
              this.element = ele;
              this.firstLine = this.element.querySelector(
                "#ey-logo-first-line rect"
              );
              this.secondLine = this.element.querySelector(
                "#ey-logo-second-line rect"
              );
              if (this.firstLine && this.secondLine) {
                this.bindEvents();
                this.animation(false);
              }
            }

            animation(scrollBool) {
              if (scrollBool) {
                if (window.scrollY == 0) {
                  this.firstLine.setAttribute("class", "slideIn");
                  this.secondLine.setAttribute("class", "slideIn");
                }
                if (window.scrollY !== 0) {
                  this.firstLine.setAttribute("class", "slideOut");
                  this.secondLine.setAttribute("class", "slideOut");
                }
              }
            }

            bindEvents() {
              window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
                this.animation(true);
              });
            }
          }

          document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            document
              .querySelectorAll(".cmp-logo__image")
              .forEach((eysvglogo) => {
                new EYLogoAnimation(eysvglogo);
              });
          });
    </script>

      <h1 data-heading="Our purpose" class="up-introduction__title-heading">
        Our purpose
      </h1>
      
    </div>
    <div class="up-introduction__container">
      <div class="up-introduction__first-paragraph"><p>At EY, our purpose is Building a better working world. The insights and quality services we provide help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over. We develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all our stakeholders. In so doing, we play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities.<a target="_blank" href="https://www.ey.com/en_in/shape-the-future-with-confidence" rel="noopener noreferrer"></a></p>
</div>
      <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph">
        <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph-proxy" data-up-hook-introduction="paragraphProxy" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph-wrapper" data-up-hook-introduction="paragraph" aria-hidden="true">
          <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph-content" data-up-hook-introduction="content">
            <p>In a world that’s changing faster than ever, our purpose acts as our North Star, guiding our 400,000 people — providing the context and meaning for the work we do every day. We help digital pioneers fight data piracy; guide governments through cash-flow crises; unlock new medical treatments with data analytics; and pursue high quality audits to build trust in financial markets and business. And now we’ve unified all our artificial intelligence (AI) innovation and development efforts under one platform, <a target="_blank" href="https://www.ey.com/en_in/newsroom/2023/09/ey-announces-launch-of-artificial-intelligence-platform-ey-ai-following-us-1-4b-investment" title="EY.ai" rel="noopener noreferrer">EY.ai</a>, to help enable clients to efficiently access the benefits of AI. It is also intended to increase transparency, trust, and confidence in AI as EY seeks to use these new capabilities to serve the broader interests of society and contribute to a more inclusive future.</p>
<p>Through our four integrated service lines — Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions, and Tax — and our deep sector knowledge, we help our clients to capitalize on new opportunities and assess and manage risk to deliver responsible growth. Our high-performing, multidisciplinary teams help them fulfill regulatory requirements, keep investors informed and meet stakeholder needs.</p>
<p>We believe a better working world is one where economic growth is sustainable and inclusive. We work continuously to improve the quality of all our services, investing in our people and innovation. And we’re proud to work with others – from our clients to wider stakeholders – to use our knowledge, skills and experience to help fulfill our purpose and create positive change.<br />
</p>
<p>Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. Together. All in. <a target="_self" href="https://www.ey.com/en_in/shape-the-future-with-confidence" rel="noopener noreferrer">Learn more</a>.</p>

          </div>
        </div>

  <div class="up-introduction__content">
    <div class="up-introduction__title">
      <h2 data-heading="Our people" class="up-introduction__title-heading">
        Our people
      </h2>
      
    </div>
    <div class="up-introduction__container">
      <div class="up-introduction__first-paragraph"><p>At EY, we are shapers of the future.</p>
</div>
      <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph">
        <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph-proxy" data-up-hook-introduction="paragraphProxy" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph-wrapper" data-up-hook-introduction="paragraph" aria-hidden="true">
          <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph-content" data-up-hook-introduction="content">
            <p>A shaper of the future is a bold and curious leader, an innovative thinker and a game changer. Through lifelong learning, we create real impact for clients and the world by building trust, harnessing new technology and working together in an inclusive culture.</p>
<p>Our purpose, Building a better working world, is the foundation of our culture. At EY, we empower our people with the right mindsets and skills to navigate what is next, pursue careers as unique as they are, and build their own exceptional EY experiences.</p>
<p>Our 400,000 people and one million alumni form a powerful network. Each of those people leads and inspires others during their time at EY and beyond and brings our purpose to life in the work they do every day. </p>
<p>The ability to invite, leverage and learn from different perspectives is key to delivering for our clients. We believe <a href="https://www.ey.com/en_in/about-us/inclusiveness/growth">inclusiveness supports growth</a> and fosters collaboration, innovation and trust.</p>
<p>We continue to invest in skills and learning for our people. This includes the first-of-its-kind <a href="https://www.ey.com/en_in/tech-mba">EY Tech MBA, in collaboration with Hult International Business School</a>. It builds on the success of our <a href="https://www.ey.com/en_in/careers/personalized-career-development">EY Badges</a> program, which helps our people develop future-focused skills in areas such as technology, sustainability and leadership.</p>

<div class="upIntroduction component aem-GridColumn--default--none aem-GridColumn aem-GridColumn--default--12 aem-GridColumn--offset--default--0"><div class="up-introduction" data-up-is="introduction" data-up-analytics="introduction" style="--introduction-paragraph-lines: 9;">
  <div class="up-introduction__content">
    <div class="up-introduction__title">
      <h2 data-heading="Inclusive growth" class="up-introduction__title-heading">
        Inclusive growth
      </h2>
      
    </div>
    <div class="up-introduction__container">
      <div class="up-introduction__first-paragraph"><p>We believe a better working world is one where everyone can contribute to and share in the benefits of sustainable economic growth.</p>
</div>
      <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph">
        <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph-proxy" data-up-hook-introduction="paragraphProxy" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph-wrapper" data-up-hook-introduction="paragraph" aria-hidden="true">
          <div class="up-introduction__second-paragraph-content" data-up-hook-introduction="content">
            <p>Over the past generation, trends such as rapidly advancing technology, increased globalization and demographic shifts have brought huge benefits, but at the same time have left many people feeling like they’re falling behind.</p>
<p>We believe economic growth and social inclusion must always be looked at together and increased overall prosperity can only be achieved along with more equal opportunity. </p>
<p>Through our services, our wider influence and our approach to corporate responsibility, we're committed to supporting broad-based growth that empowers everyone to contribute to and benefit from economic success, both today and tomorrow.</p>

01 May 2026 Our purpose At EY, our purpose is Building a better working world. The insights and quality services we provide help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over. We develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all our stakeholders. In so doing, we play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. In a world that’s changing faster than ever, our purpose acts as our North Star, guiding our 400,000 people — providing the context and meaning for the work we do every day. We help digital pioneers fight data piracy; guide governments through cash-flow crises; unlock new medical treatments with data analytics; and pursue high quality audits to build trust in financial markets and business. And now we’ve unified all our artificial intelligence (AI) innovation and development efforts under one platform, EY.ai , to help enable clients to efficiently access the benefits of AI. It is also intended to increase transparency, trust, and confidence in AI as EY seeks to use these new capabilities to serve the broader interests of society and contribute to a more inclusive future. Through our four integrated service lines — Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions, and Tax — and our deep sector knowledge, we help our clients to capitalize on new opportunities and assess and manage risk to deliver responsible growth. Our high-performing, multidisciplinary teams help them fulfill regulatory requirements, keep investors informed and meet stakeholder needs. We believe a better working world is one where economic growth is sustainable and inclusive. We work continuously to improve the quality of all our services, investing in our people and innovation. And we’re proud to work with others – from our clients to wider stakeholders – to use our knowledge, skills and experience to help fulfill our purpose and create positive change. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. Together. All in. Learn more . Read more Read less Our people At EY, we are shapers of the future. A shaper of the future is a bold and curious leader, an innovative thinker and a game changer. Through lifelong learning, we create real impact for clients and the world by building trust, harnessing new technology and working together in an inclusive culture. Our purpose, Building a better working world, is the foundation of our culture. At EY, we empower our people with the right mindsets and skills to navigate what is next, pursue careers as unique as they are, and build their own exceptional EY experiences.
